all_found.desc: [ADVISORY] The 'legacy ledger is a directory' case asserts only a nonzero exit from `state` in a harness with no runs, and resolveRun already fails there with ERR_NO_RUNS, so the assertion holds even if roots() ignored MigrateLegacyRows' error. A regression that silently swallows a ledger-migration failure passes CI.

[ADVISORY] The corrected sentence says `metareview status` lists the abandoned runs of the worktree it runs in; only `metareview status --json` (DiscoverAbandonedRuns, worktree-filtered) does that, while plain `metareview status` (StatusLines) lists every run in the shared common-dir store from all worktrees and names unmigrated 0.13.x runs. A reader running plain status in a linked worktree sees other worktrees' and finished runs and may conclude attribution is broken.

[ADVISORY] No test reaches the Report.Warnings entry buildFor adds when LegacyRunsPending is true: the deterministic mutation pass reports both string-concatenation mutants on status.go:228 as NOT COVERED. If the warning is dropped or names the wrong path, 0.13.x upgraders get no status hint and CI does not notice.

rejected.desc: [ADVISORY] StatusLines (plain `metareview status` FSM section) reads only the common-dir store, with neither the 0.13.x legacy fallback nor the migration. Right after upgrading, plain status prints 'fsm runs: none' while legacy runs exist, contradicting status --json's warning.

[ADVISORY] The architecture doc and the repo.StoreDir comment say the shared store exists in a bare repository, but ctxDeps.roots() still resolves storeRoot first and returns ERR_NOT_A_REPO for a bare main worktree. Bare-clone users are told it works while every fsm command refuses there; #174 is not fixed by this part.

[ADVISORY] The edited retention paragraph still says '`metareview status` lists the runs of the main worktree', but the scan is now scoped to the worktree containing each run's work_dir and SKILL.md says so. The two docs contradict each other; agents misread status from a linked worktree.
